notes: Page shows four panels of a minifigure opening the box, sorting the pieces and starting to build. No pieces are placed.
Step 1: white sloped brick 15571 is pressed onto the studs of bracket 99780.

Step 2 (2x): two white 2x2 corner plates are added. The picture shows one already at the right of the bracket and the second pushed up from below. I have assumed the first corner plate (b3) clutches the bracket (b1) and the second (b4) clutches the underside of b3. The exact contact is hard to read from the drawing.

Step 3 has a 2x callout, but the drawing shows only one corner plate being lowered onto the two right-hand studs of the assembly. I listed two white corner plates (b5, b6), because the parts list has exactly two left and no later page is known to use them.
I assumed both plates sit on the earlier corner plates b3 and b4. The second copy's exact position is not visible.
The drawing is rotated compared with page 3, so I could not tell which earlier plate sits under which new plate.
Sub-step 1: the blue 1x4 brick goes onto the white 1x4 plate. Sub-step 2: the printed 1x4 brick with the yellow stripe goes on top of the blue brick, giving a three-piece stack.
The stack is then pushed onto the existing white plate assembly. The drawing is rotated, so I assumed the white plate (b7) clutches the top corner plates b5 and b6. This is uncertain.
Step 5 (2x): two white round 2x2 bricks with axle hole are stacked, then the stack is pushed onto the white plates in front of the blue brick stack.
I assumed the lower round brick (b10) sits on the top corner plates b5 and b6. The drawing is rotated, so this is a guess.
Sub-step 1: a white 1x4 plate is shown on its own. Sub-step 2: it is clutched under a white 2x4 plate, offset to one side, so the 2x4 plate sits on its studs.

The 2x4 plate is then pushed onto the front of the model, beside the round-brick stack. I assumed it also clutches the lower corner plates b3 and b4. The exact contacts are a guess from the rotated drawing.

Step 7 (2x): each copy puts a light bluish gray 1x2x1 2/3 brick with 4 side studs on a white 1x2 plate. The two sub-assemblies go on either side of the round-brick stack, with the side studs facing outward.
I assumed both 1x2 plates clutch the white 2x4 plate b13. The exact studs are a guess from the drawing, and I could not tell which way the side studs face.

Step 8: one blue 2x4 plate is laid on top, in front of the blue 1x4 brick row. I assumed it sits on the top round brick (b11) and the two gray side-stud bricks (b15, b17). The back blue brick row stands beside it.

The remaining-parts list dropped the Tan 22885 brick and one gray one after page 8. So one of the two bricks placed on page 8 may really be tan, although both looked gray in the drawing. I kept both as Light Bluish Gray.

Step 9 (2x): each copy lays a blue 1x2 tile with groove on a blue 1x2 plate. The two pairs are then pushed sideways onto the side studs of the two gray bricks (b15 and b17), one on each side of the model.
The side attachment is read from the drawing, where the blue pieces stick out at the left and right under the blue 2x4 plate. The exact side studs used are a guess.

The remaining-parts list dropped only the blue 1x2 plate line (3023). It still shows 3x blue 3069b tiles. I took the second piece to be a blue 3069b tile, as drawn, so the tracker may be out of step by two tiles.

Step 10 (2x): each copy puts a white 1x2 plate with a side clip on a white 1x2 plate. The clip faces outward. The pairs are pushed sideways onto the gray side-stud bricks, below the blue pairs from step 9, one on each side.

The side studs used (the lower two on each gray brick) are read from the drawing and are a guess. The remaining-parts list still showed the 11476 clip plates after this page. I treated that as a tracker lag, since the drawing clearly shows them.

Sub-step 1: a blue 1x1 brick goes on each end of the white 1x4 plate (b28, b29). Sub-step 2: the printed bow-tie 1x2x2 brick goes in the middle (b30). A second blue 1x1 brick is stacked on each end brick (b31, b32), so all four 1x1 bricks are used.
The finished panel is attached to the front of the model, with the white plate at the base. I assumed the plate clutches the white 2x4 plate b13. The exact contact is a guess from the drawing.

Step 12: five light bluish gray and one tan 1x2x1 2/3 brick with 4 side studs are placed on top of the body, forming a ring (the head base). The tan brick goes at the front, above the bow tie, with its side studs facing forward.

The exact positions and which bricks each one clutches are guesses from the small drawing. I assumed the tan brick sits on the bow-tie brick b30. I assumed the gray bricks sit on the 1x1 bricks b31 and b32 at the front, and on the blue plate b18 and the blue brick row b9 at the back.
The remaining-parts list had already dropped the Tan 22885 earlier and still showed 12 gray ones. Its counts for this part do not match my pieces.

Step 13: a separate sub-assembly, not yet attached to the main model. Two Medium Azure 2x2 bricks are stacked. The dark bluish gray 2x2 round plate with axle hole goes on top, then the Bright Pink 2x2 brick.
I took the round plate to sit with its studs up, as the drawing shows, so the pink brick clutches its studs.
No new pieces are used on this page. It shows the stack from step 13 (azure, azure, gray round plate, pink brick) being lowered into the ring of gray and tan bricks on top of the body.

I assumed the bottom azure brick (b39) clutches the blue 2x4 plate b18. The drawing shows only the pink brick moving, with an azure layer already visible, but the stack was built as one unit on page 14. I could not confirm which studs it clutches.

Step 14: six light bluish gray 1x2x1 2/3 bricks with 4 side studs are placed on top of the first head ring. They surround the pink brick, with the pink brick showing in the middle. Their side studs face outward.
I assumed this layer overlaps the first ring (b33-b38) so that each brick bridges two bricks of the layer below. The exact positions are a guess from the small drawing.
Step 15: a white 4x4 plate caps the head. I assumed it clutches all six gray bricks of the second ring (b43-b48) and the pink brick (b42) in the middle.
Step 16 (2x): two black round 4x4 plates with pin hole are stacked on the white 4x4 plate on top of the head. The drawing shows the second one being lowered onto the first, which is already in place.
Step 17: a white 4x4 plate is pressed sideways onto the side studs on the front of the head. This is the face plate.

I took the front studs to be those of the tan brick b33 and the gray bricks b43 and b44. The drawing shows 16 studs covered, so other front bricks (for example b34 and b35) may also be involved. I could not tell from the small image.

Step 18: a white 1x4 tile with groove (b53), a white 1x4 plate with 2 studs (b54) and four white quarter-round 1x1 tiles (b55-b58) are added to the face plate b52. This builds the eye-area and cheek shapes.

The drawing shows the face plate tilted, and I could not tell exactly which studs of b52 each piece clutches. I recorded all six as resting on b52. Some of the quarter tiles may sit on the 2 studs of b54, so that part is a guess.
I also could not tell which 1x4 piece is the plate and which is the tile. I matched them to the small icons in the parts box: the flat one is the tile, and the one with studs is the plate.

Step 19: sub-step 1 puts a Bright Light Orange 1x2 plate on a white 1x2 plate. Sub-step 2 adds the two curved 1x2 bricks at the two ends. Sub-step 3 covers the two orange studs between them with an orange 1x2 tile with groove. This is the beak, built as a separate unit and not yet attached to the model.

The callout also lists two small round pieces (2x), which I took to be the black eye tiles (98138pr0060). They do not appear in sub-steps 1-3 on this page, so I did not place them here and will record them when they are fitted on the next page.
I assumed both curved bricks clutch the white plate b59. The drawing makes the exact studs hard to tell.
The two black eye tiles (b64, b65) are on the face above the beak. I assumed they sit on the 2 studs of the white 1x4 plate b54.
The finished beak (b59-b63) is attached to the lower part of the face plate. I assumed it joins b52 via the studs of the white plate b59. The exact studs are a guess.
Step 20 (2x): two white 2x4 tiles with groove are pressed sideways onto the side studs of the head, one above the other. The drawing shows both on the left side of the head.
The tiles have no studs, so they are joined only by the side studs. I assumed the lower tile covers b34 and b36 and the upper tile covers b45 and b47. The exact bricks are a guess.
The right side of the head may be covered by later steps.

Step 21: a white 4x4 plate is pressed sideways onto the side of the head opposite the two white tiles, with its studs facing outward. I assumed it covers the side studs of the four gray bricks on that side (b35, b37, b46, b48). The drawing is rotated, so this is a guess.
Step 22 (2x): two white 2x4 tiles with groove cover the 16 studs of the white 4x4 side plate b68, one above the other. The head now shows two white tiles on each side.
Step 23 (2x): the model is turned around and two white 2x4 tiles with groove are pressed onto the back-facing side studs of the head, one above the other.
My earlier ring layout is itself a guess. I assumed the back studs belong to b36 and b37 (lower ring) and b47 and b48 (upper ring). The back brick b38 may also be involved.

Step 24 (2x): each copy stacks two Bright Light Orange 1x2 plates. The model is shown upside down, with the black round plates at the bottom of the picture. The two stacks go onto the underside of the body, where they become Donald's feet.

I assumed the stacks clutch the free anti-studs on the underside of the white 2x4 plate b13. I recorded this as other_joins because the stacks sit below the base. Which orange plate touches the model, and which exact studs, is a guess.
Step 25: an orange left wedge plate 3x2 and an orange right wedge plate 3x2 are pressed onto the two orange plate stacks (the feet). The model is still shown upside down.
I assumed the left wedge (43723) goes on the stack b74 and the right wedge (43722) on b76. The drawing does not clearly show which foot gets which.

Step 26: the model is turned upright again and the hat top is started. A blue 1x4 plate (b79), a blue 1x3 plate (b80) and a blue 1x1 plate with horizontal clip (b81) are laid on the black round 4x4 plate b51. The clip plate sits at the end of the 1x3 plate, making a row of four, with its clip pointing out to the left.
I assumed all three clutch the top black round plate b51. Their exact studs are a guess from the drawing.

Step 27 (2x): two blue curved 2x2x2/3 bricks cap the hat plates. I assumed the two plate rows (b79 on one side, b80 plus the clip plate b81 on the other) form a 2x4 area, with b82 over the clip end and b83 over the other end.
The exact contacts are a guess, and I took the clip end to be the left end of the 1x3 plate.

Step 28: three pieces are added to the hat. A black 1x2 plate with handle (b84) is clipped onto the blue clip plate b81 and sticks out to the left of the hat. A blue 1x2 tile with groove (b85) and a blue 30-degree 1x2 slope (b86) go onto the blue curved bricks.

I could not tell exactly which studs of b82 and b83 the tile and the slope clutch. I also assumed the black piece is the 1x2 handle plate, because its icon shows the handle, even though the model drawing makes it look longer.
Step 29 starts the display base. Sub-step 1 is the black 6x6 plate. Sub-step 2 puts the black 2x4 tile with groove on it.

The callout also lists a black 1x4 tile with groove and a black 1x4 plate with 2 studs and 3 bottom tubes. The sub-step 2 drawing shows only one stud, and I could not tell whether those two pieces are already on the plate. I left them for the next page and will record them there if they appear.
No new pieces on this page. The finished figure is set upright on the black 6x6 base, with the two orange wedge-plate feet clutching the base studs.

The black 2x4 tile b88 shows on the base between the feet. The black 1x4 tile and the black 1x4 plate with 2 studs from the step 29 callout are not visible yet, so I have not placed them. I will record them on a later page if they appear.
The remaining-parts list still shows a White 2431 tile, but I used the white one on page 20. The step 29 callout and drawing show a black 1x4 tile, so the remaining one should be the black 2431.
Advertisement for the BrickHeadz sets 40378 Pluto and Goofy. No pieces are placed.

Still unplaced: one black 1x4 tile with groove (the tracker lists it as white) and one black 1x4 plate with 2 studs and 3 bottom tubes (92593). They were listed in the step 29 callout but I have not seen them placed yet.
This page is a feedback-prize advertisement with no building step.

Two pieces from the step 29 callout were never shown placed: the black 1x4 plate with 2 studs and 3 bottom tubes (92593) and the black 1x4 tile with groove (2431). I recorded them here so the inventory is complete. This is a guess. I assumed the 92593 plate sits on the black 6x6 base b87, next to the 2x4 tile b88, and the 1x4 tile caps it. Their true position is not shown on any page I saw.
The remaining-parts tracker listed a white 2431 tile, but I used the white one on page 20. I recorded the leftover tile as Black, matching the step 29 drawing.
